verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents annual-report deadline reminders through its Compliance Calendar and registered agent service, and real-time compliance-status notifications on its annual report page. Those snippets only show reminders and status tracking; that LegalZoom actually files reports for you is implied by the page URL, not stated. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that LegalZoom submits annual reports to the state, any franchise tax filing or payment support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of on-time filing.
